items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Willie Pickens is teaching a lot of people, and sometimes when he’s on the bill, he’ll have them come up and play

ctx.x: Some of them do, some of them are very good and talk. Eric Reed is very good, he explains the songs: Four bars, four bars, a bridge, four bars, and all that kind of stuff. Some of them are very good; some of them just go ahead and play their regular stuff. It’s always good. Sometimes we have the kids come up afterwards and sit down at the piano or whatever they do, there’s a lot of them learning. Willie Pickens is teaching a lot of people, and sometimes when he’s on the bill, he’ll have them come up and play,…
Just for the historic record, Willie was here last night -
